acetaminophen_500mg.name: Acetaminophen 500 mg
acetaminophen_500mg.indications: Mild-to-moderate pain (headache, muscle ache) and fever reduction.
acetaminophen_500mg.adult_dosage: 500 mg orally (up to 3,000 mg max per 24 hours per ISS cap; MedlinePlus adult OTC limit <= 4,000 mg/24h).
acetaminophen_500mg.warnings: Avoid exceeding daily hepatic limit or stacking with other acetaminophen products; preferred over NSAIDs when dehydrated or nauseated.

ibuprofen_400mg.name: Ibuprofen 400 mg
ibuprofen_400mg.indications: Mild-to-moderate inflammatory pain, musculoskeletal / ARED soreness, headache, and fever.
ibuprofen_400mg.adult_dosage: 400 mg every 4 to 6 hours with food (OTC self-care cap <= 1,200 mg/day).
ibuprofen_400mg.warnings: Do NOT take if dehydrated, dizzy/orthostatic, nauseated, or having kidney/GI ulcer risks; NSAIDs carry GI bleeding and renal/CV precautions.
ibuprofen_400mg.source_citation: MedlinePlus / NIH & Eyal et al. (2019) Pharm Res — NSAID Contraindications

oral_rehydration_salts.name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
oral_rehydration_salts.indications: Mild-to-moderate dehydration, orthostatic dizziness, post-EVA fluid deficit, and elevated resting heart rate from low blood volume.
oral_rehydration_salts.adult_dosage: Dissolve 1 packet completely in 500 mL potable water; sip gradually.
oral_rehydration_salts.warnings: Do not mix in boiling water or add extra sugar/salt; seek urgent medical review if persistent vomiting or inability to keep fluids down occurs.
oral_rehydration_salts.source_citation: MedlinePlus / WHO ORS Formulation & Mayo Clinic Dehydration Care

meclizine_25mg.name: Meclizine 25 mg
meclizine_25mg.indications: Space motion sickness, movement-triggered dizziness/vertigo, and nausea.
meclizine_25mg.adult_dosage: 25 mg orally (standard range 25 to 50 mg); max 2 tablets/day under ISS operational rationing.
meclizine_25mg.warnings: Causes drowsiness and anticholinergic dry mouth/blurred vision; avoid before safety-critical EVA, robotics, or docking duties.

ondansetron_8mg.name: Ondansetron 8 mg ODT
ondansetron_8mg.indications: Non-sedating prevention/relief of acute nausea, vomiting, and space motion sickness.
ondansetron_8mg.adult_dosage: Dissolve one 8 mg ODT tablet on tongue without water; max 2 doses/day.
ondansetron_8mg.warnings: Use caution with QT-prolonging risks, electrolyte imbalance, or serotonergic drugs.

melatonin_3mg.name: Melatonin 3 mg
melatonin_3mg.indications: Short-term circadian entrainment and sleep-onset support during orbital light/dark shifts.
melatonin_3mg.adult_dosage: 3 mg orally 30 to 60 minutes before scheduled sleep period (typical adult range 0.5 to 5 mg).
melatonin_3mg.warnings: Avoid before alertness-critical tasks; monitor if heart rate or blood pressure symptoms coexist and pause if daytime dizziness worsens.
melatonin_3mg.source_citation: MedlinePlus / NIH — Melatonin Dietary Supplement Reference
